channel.title: Lakefront Luxury
channel.desc: Retired couple Heather and Yvan are searching for a lakefront home to host friends and family and give Yvan space to rehearse music. Their first stop is a rustic retreat with vaulted pine ceilings, a stone fireplace, a double-sided primary fireplace, a huge kitchen, and a three-season room perfect for entertaining. Next, a modern lake house wows with steel beams, walls of glass, a spa-inspired ensuite, and a guest house surrounded by landscaped gardens.
